measurement.cache_condition: uncontrolled; provider cache hits not observed

failure_policy: stop on first failure or refusal; preserve artifacts; no automatic resume
total_cost_reason: Unpriced hosted preparation/inference and unmeasured local compute; subtotal is an estimate, not results
validation: Pinned public Hugging Face CSV/Parquet loaders; no real-dataset training or paid inference

source.split_policy: synthetic 60/20/20 stratified exact-input groups; not official splits
source.secondary_label_policy: metadata only; never additional classification targets

supplemental_annotations.join: exact post equality only; preserve all matching rows; no inferred explanations

classes.name: white_grievance
classes.description: Implicit hate expressing frustration at a minority group's perceived privilege or portraying white people as unfairly victimized.

classes.name: incitement
classes.description: Implicit hate promoting hate groups or ideologies, encouraging solidarity or flaunting in-group power.

classes.name: inferiority
classes.description: Implicit hate implying that a demographic group or its members have less worth or are inferior to others.

classes.name: irony
classes.description: Implicit hate using sarcasm, humor or satire to demean a demographic group or its members.

classes.name: stereotypical
classes.description: Implicit hate associating a demographic group with negative attributes through stereotypes, euphemisms or metaphors.

classes.name: threatening
classes.description: Implicit hate indirectly committing to or advocating harm to a group's body, well-being, reputation or liberty.

source.cross_split_duplicate_policy: test > dev > train; exclude exact duplicate inputs from lower-priority candidates; merge annotations into existing owner; unique examples never move

classes.name: entailment
classes.description: Given the premise, the hypothesis must be true. Judge the hypothesis only against information supported by the premise.

classes.name: neutral
classes.description: Given the premise, the hypothesis could be true or false: the premise does not establish or rule it out.

classes.name: contradiction
classes.description: Given the premise, the hypothesis must be false: it conflicts with information in the premise.
